prompt.shared: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one opaque square fantasy MMORPG inventory item icon for World of ClaudeCraft, item style contract woc-item-icon-v1. Premium hand-painted classic fantasy MMO inventory art with tactile materials, crisp focal edges, softer peripheral brushwork, warm top-left key light, cool deep bottom-right shadow, a complete centered silhouette, safe padding and an opaque dark painted vignette. No text, pseudo-writing, label, UI border, rarity frame, watermark, transparency, person, portal, crop or photorealism.
prompt.cartographers_ink: Paint Cartographer's Ink as one stout old glass bottle filled with deep midnight blue-black ink, sealed by worn cork. A short clean feather quill rests through a brass neck loop, a tiny rolled blank parchment strip is tied to the bottle, and one simple compass-star emblem is embossed directly in the glass. It must read first as ink, not a potion or explosive.
prompt.treasure_map_common: Paint the Weathered Treasure Map as one old partly unrolled cream parchment map with frayed dirt-smudged paper, faded green cord, a few broad dark route marks and one bold red X. Keep the common quality modest and practical.
prompt.treasure_map_rare: Paint the Inked Treasure Map as one carefully inked partly unrolled parchment with dark blue coastlines, a broad dotted route, one bold red X, navy cord and a compact blue wax seal. Keep it practical but visibly finer than the common map.
prompt.treasure_map_epic: Paint the Gilded Treasure Map as one luxurious partly unrolled parchment with subtle hammered gold caps and edge, rich purple cord, amethyst-purple wax seal, broad map lines, a dotted route and one bold red X. Use restrained purple and gold accents without a baked border.
prompt.treasure_map_legendary: Paint the Sovereign Treasure Map as one magnificent royal partly unrolled parchment with aged gold end caps and corners, burnt orange silk cord, amber-orange wax seal with a simple crown-like compass emblem, fine broad cartographic lines, a dotted route and one bold red X. Make it legendary at a glance without overwhelming glow.
